title: Step 1 — the payer bank registers a 10,000,000 CRC fiat deposit
description: Banco de San Jose tells BCCR it is depositing 10,000,000 CRC of fiat funds. BCCR creates a PENDING deposit record and returns deposit_id. Nothing has moved on any chain yet.
notes: Gateway: Banco de San Jose commercial-bank gateway (spoke-crc), which proxies to BCCR. The create half of the reserve lifecycle is registered only on a commercial-bank gateway; a Central Bank gateway answers 404 on this path. Send only amount: the proxy overwrites requester_besu_address and requester_paladin_identity from the verified caller. Divergence from the contract, verified in the delivered gateway (internal/adapters/payment/payment_grpc.go RegisterDepositResult): the 201 body is {deposit_id} alone — there is no status field, although both the platform OpenAPI document and contracts/pvp declare one.
